items.title: File Widerspruch against benefit cancellation
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Agentur für Arbeit Musterbergen, Bahnhofstraße 12, 35037 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter is dated (posted) 27.08.2026 (Thursday), a Bundesagentur für Arbeit decision governed by SGB X (a social-law body). Per the letter's own clause and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a posted notice is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: counting from 27.08 (day of posting, not counted) gives 28.08 (day1), 29.08 (day2), 30.08 (day3), 31.08.2026 (day4, Monday). For social-law bodies the deemed-delivery day does not move even onto a weekend/holiday, but 31.08.2026 is already a working day (Monday), so Bekanntgabe = 31.08.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 37 SGB X, counted per §§ 187, 188 BGB) starts the next day (01.09.2026) and ends on the day of the following month numerically matching the event day (31); September has only 30 days, so per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the period ends on the last day of that month: 30.09.2026 (Wednesday, not a holiday in NRW), so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB is needed.
